name: Evidence satisfies exit
description: Estimate whether available evidence actually satisfies the defined exit or lifecycle-transition conditions.
when_to_use: Use before accepting, closing, promoting, or claiming a governed item complete.

content.description: Exit condition, definition of done, or requirement summary

verification_summary.description: What was actually verified and how

browser_or_ui_in_scope.description: Whether browser/UI behavior is in scope

browser_verification_present.description: Whether actual browser/UI verification is present

evidence_satisfies_exit.instructions: Estimate whether the available evidence satisfies the supplied exit/transition requirements, applied as written: do not add unstated requirements, and do not waive stated ones. Check required evidence classes, not merely whether some evidence exists. For browser/UI work, actual browser verification must be present when required. Independent verification must be present when required. Unit tests alone do not satisfy browser/UI verification. A claimed result without observable/read-back evidence should lean false.

criteria.true: Required evidence exists, is relevant to the exit conditions, required verification was actually exercised, and no stated unresolved blocker prevents the transition.
criteria.false: Required evidence is missing, irrelevant, only asserted rather than observed, required browser/independent verification is absent, or exit conditions remain unresolved.
